description: Weld ten stake pockets to the bed plate PUC-1200 along the four wall lines (3 per side, 2 per end, colinear within each line) and introduce the drop-in wall kit PUC-1800: two side panels PUC-1810, two end panels PUC-1820 and four corner brackets PUC-1830 with M8 wing nuts. Panels drop straight through the pockets and rest on the deck. Adds 22.7 kg to the cart and raises usable load volume from a flat deck to 0.28 m3. No change to the frame, drive, power or control systems.
reason_for_change: Field reports: the flat deck sheds loose loads (gravel, offcuts, hand tools) on the ramp and over rough ground, and operators have been strapping plywood to the deck instead. Add a purpose-built 300 mm wall kit that fits and removes without tools, so the cart keeps its flat-deck use for long stock.
